papers.title: PhyDEX: A Benchmark for Physical Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models via Dynamic Extrinsic Dexterity
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have advanced rapidly in language-conditioned robotic manipulation, yet existing benchmarks mainly evaluate gripper--object contact and largely ignore how objects interact with the environment through gravity, friction, inertia, and mass distribution. As a result, it remains unclear whether current policies truly understand physics or merely interpolate from their training data. We address this gap through the lens of dynamic extrinsic dexterity and introduce PhyDEX, a throwing benchmark in which a robot must infer an object's mass, center of mass, and friction to send it to a destination beyond its kinematic workspace. PhyDEX contains 35K trajectories (143 hours) across nine tasks and 100 scenes, covering uniform, irregular, and dynamic-mass objects with static, multiple, and moving destinations. All data are generated by a scalable, fully automatic pipeline that combines grasp generation, motion planning, and closed-loop throw optimization under randomized physical properties. We evaluate three representative VLAs, GR00T N1.7, DynamicVLA, and ForceVLA, and find that all achieve success rates below 3\%. Our analysis reveals two key bottlenecks: limited robustness of pretrained models, which causes most failures before the throw, and physical blindness, as providing ground-truth physical properties roughly doubles success. Experiments on a humanoid robot and in the real world show the same failure patterns. We hope PhyDEX will drive the development of physically grounded robot policies.

ai_summary.problem: 现有VLA模型评测主要关注夹爪与物体接触，忽略了重力、摩擦、惯性、质量分布等环境物理交互，难以判断策略是否真正理解物理。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出PhyDEX，一个基于动态外部灵巧性的抛掷基准，要求机器人推断物体质量、质心和摩擦，将物体抛到运动学工作空间之外；包含3.5万条轨迹、9个任务、100个场景，并通过自动流程结合抓取生成、运动规划和闭环抛掷优化生成数据。
ai_summary.result: 评估GR00T N1.7、DynamicVLA和ForceVLA，成功率均低于3%；主要瓶颈是预训练模型鲁棒性不足导致抛掷前失败，以及“物理盲”，提供真实物理属性可使成功率约翻倍，人形机器人和真实世界实验也呈现相同失败模式。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出了面向VLA物理推理的动态外部灵巧性抛掷基准，系统暴露当前模型在物理理解上的不足。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能和机器人策略提供了检验物理 grounding 的新基准，推动更懂物理的VLA与机器人策略发展。

papers.title: Plan4D: Generative Plannable 4D Worlds
papers.abstract: Most world models for future prediction prioritize aestetic quality of generated videos, but offer only weak physical grounding and limited geometric consistency over time, due to the lack of explicit 4D modeling. In this paper, we introduce plan4d, a possible next milestone towards building a generative plannable 4D world model that predicts future RGB videos together with dense 4D geometry, including depth, cameras, point clouds, and scene flow from an observed scene context and text-specified actions. Since training data with paired actions and dense 4D annotations is inherently scarce, plan4d leverages the complementary priors of foundational video generators and 3D reconstructors. Specifically, we propose a model-stitching architecture that couples Depth Anything 3 with LongCat-Video and augments it with an auxiliary DPT head for scene-flow prediction. The resulting model allows us to plan and generate complex, long-horizon, and fine-grained actions in a dynamic 3D scenes, while substantially improving both visual fidelity and geometric accuracy of the generated future videos. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that plan4d achieves state-of-the-art performance in generative 4D modeling of environmental reactions. Project Page: https://fogradio.github.io/plan4d-project

ai_summary.problem: 现有世界模型生成未来视频时偏重视觉美感，缺乏显式4D建模，导致物理基础薄弱、时序几何一致性差，且难以根据文本动作进行可控规划。
ai_summary.method: 提出Plan4D，一种模型拼接架构：将3D重建基础模型Depth Anything 3与视频生成模型LongCat-Video耦合，并附加辅助DPT头预测场景流，从而在给定场景上下文和文本动作下同时生成未来RGB视频与稠密4D几何（深度、相机、点云、场景流）。
ai_summary.result: 在合成与真实数据集上，Plan4D在环境反应的生成式4D建模上达到SOTA，可规划并生成长时程、细粒度的复杂动作，同时显著提升生成视频的视觉保真度与几何精度。
ai_summary.novelty: 通过复用视频生成与3D重建两类基础模型的互补先验并以模型拼接方式绕开配对4D标注数据稀缺问题，实现可规划的RGB+稠密4D几何联合预测。
ai_summary.relevance: 为世界模型从“好看视频”迈向具备几何一致性与动作可控性的4D物理世界建模提供了可行路径，对具身智能与规划式仿真有直接价值。

papers.title: Mind2Act World: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Embodied Mind, Physical Action, and Mind-Action Composition in Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Embodied intelligence aims to let robots perform complex physical tasks with human-like adaptability and reliability, which requires three complementary capabilities: history-based cognitive reasoning, precise and timely physical execution, and the composition of reasoning and execution through environmental feedback. Yet existing benchmarks either evaluate reasoning and execution within the same tasks or assess them separately without their composition, so they reveal little about whether a failure comes from reasoning, execution, or their composition. We introduce Mind2Act World, a diagnostic benchmark of 30 simulated manipulation tasks from five real-world application domains. Each task has three difficulty levels and two scene settings (Clean and Random), yielding 180 configurations. The tasks form three views: Mind tests decisions based on past observations, Act tests precise and timely execution, and Mind2Act combines both in closed-loop tasks where action outcomes guide later decisions. Comparing the three views shows whether a system lacks a capability or fails to compose capabilities it already has. A diagnosis harness further attributes the failed episodes of three representative systems to Mind, Act, or their composition and summarizes each system in a profile card. Our evaluation of multimodal agents, vision-language-action models (VLAs), and world-action models (WAMs) shows that competence in a single view does not carry over to Mind2Act tasks. Even the strongest agent succeeds in 52.7% of Mind and 39.0% of Act episodes but in only 12.0% of Mind2Act episodes. The strongest agent retains task state but struggles with sustained contact, whereas end-to-end policies execute practiced motions but retain little task state. These findings point to composing reasoning and execution through environmental feedback as the main open problem.

ai_summary.problem: 现有具身智能基准要么在同一任务中同时评估推理与执行，要么将二者分开评估却缺少组合测试，因此难以判断失败来自推理、执行还是二者的组合。
ai_summary.method: 提出 Mind2Act World 诊断性基准，包含 5 个真实应用领域的 30 个模拟操作任务，每任务 3 个难度和 Clean/Random 两种场景，共 180 种配置；设计 Mind、Act、Mind2Act 三个视图，并配有诊断工具将失败回合归因到推理、执行或二者组合。
ai_summary.result: 评估多模态智能体、VLA 和 WAM 后发现单视图能力不能迁移到组合任务：最强智能体在 Mind 和 Act 上分别成功 52.7% 和 39.0%，但在 Mind2Act 上仅 12.0%；其能保留任务状态却难以维持持续接触，端到端策略能执行熟练动作但状态保持较弱。
ai_summary.novelty: 将具身能力拆解为基于历史的决策、精确及时的物理执行以及闭环组合三个可诊断视图，并提供失败归因与系统画像卡。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能/机器人操作提供了区分并诊断推理、执行及其组合瓶颈的评估框架，指出通过环境反馈组合推理与执行是核心开放问题。

papers.title: Awaken-HI: Scaling Humanoid Intelligence with Whole-Body Human Experience
papers.abstract: A central goal of humanoid robotics is for robots to perform the everyday work people do in homes and workplaces. Existing egocentric video datasets cover many of these activities but provide little synchronized whole-body motion data for learning loco-manipulation at scale. We build Awaken-Human, which pairs approximately 50,000 hours of egocentric stereo video with synchronized whole-body human motion and covers more than 100 skills. Building on this, we also introduce Awaken-HI (Humanoid Intelligence), a vision-language-action model for humanoid loco-manipulation that jointly predicts original human motion and retargeted robot actions through a shared action expert. We show that loco-manipulation skills transfer more effectively from people to humanoids when human trajectories directly supervise the shared action expert. Increasing human pretraining data reduces held-out robot action prediction error according to an empirical scaling law and raises the mean success rate on downstream real-robot tasks. After full-corpus pretraining and T800 adaptation, Awaken-HI achieves a mean success rate of 93.75% across eight individual tasks and outperforms GR00T N1.7 and $π_{0.5}$ in both individual and long-horizon evaluations. The same policy generalizes to objects unseen during robot post-training and to new pairings of familiar objects and destinations.

ai_summary.problem: 人形机器人需要在家和办公场景中完成日常全身移动操作任务，但现有第一视角视频数据缺乏大规模同步全身运动数据，难以支撑移动操作技能学习。
ai_summary.method: 论文构建 Awaken-Human 数据集，约5万小时第一视角立体视频，同步全身人体运动，覆盖100多种技能；并提出 Awaken-HI 视觉-语言-动作模型，通过共享动作专家联合预测原始人体运动和重定向后的机器人动作。
ai_summary.result: 实验表明，用人体轨迹直接监督共享动作专家能更有效地将移动操作技能迁移到人形机器人；增加人体预训练数据可降低机器人动作预测误差并提升真实机器人任务成功率。完整预训练和T800适配后，Awaken-HI 在8个单项任务上平均成功率达93.75%，优于GR00T N1.7和π0.5，并具备一定泛化能力。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是构建大规模同步全身人体运动的第一视角数据集，并用共享动作专家实现人体运动与机器人动作的联合建模和技能迁移。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作为人形机器人VLA模型提供了可扩展的人类经验预训练范式，推动人类技能向具身智能体迁移。
ai_summary.org: EngineAI

papers.title: ScaleWorld: High-Resolution World Generation through Shared Prediction and Refinement
papers.abstract: High-resolution generation enables video world models to render fine-grained scene structures and textures, but directly generating high-resolution video incurs substantial computational and memory costs. We present ScaleWorld, a causal video model that unifies low-resolution world prediction and high-resolution refinement within a single shared backbone. By refining its own predictions, ScaleWorld produces high-resolution world videos without requiring a separate refinement model. For each video chunk, the shared backbone first completes a low-resolution prediction and then performs one-step high-resolution refinement conditioned on that prediction. To support efficient streaming generation, we maintain separate causal states with a long low-resolution history for prediction and a short high-resolution history for refinement. To address task interference during distillation, we separate specialist optimization from capability consolidation and introduce task-asymmetric on-policy distillation (TA-OPD). This procedure transfers prediction and refinement behaviors from specialized teachers into a shared student through local velocity matching under their respective sampling and history policies. {Extensive experiments demonstrate that ScaleWorld achieves high-quality world generation with improved computational and memory efficiency.

ai_summary.problem: 高分辨率视频世界模型生成精细场景结构与纹理时计算与显存开销巨大，而低分辨率预测又损失细节，如何在单一模型中兼顾高分辨率画质与生成效率。
ai_summary.method: 提出 ScaleWorld，一个因果视频模型，用同一个共享主干先对每个视频块做低分辨率世界预测，再以该预测为条件做一步高分辨率精炼，从而无需独立精炼模型；同时为预测维护长低分辨率因果状态、为精炼维护短高分辨率因果状态以支持流式生成。为缓解蒸馏中的任务干扰，提出任务非对称在线策略蒸馏（TA-OPD），将专门教师模型的预测与精炼行为通过各自采样与历史策略下的局部速度匹配合并进共享学生模型。
ai_summary.result: 实验表明 ScaleWorld 能生成高质量的世界视频，并在计算与显存效率上明显优于直接高分辨率生成方案。
ai_summary.novelty: 用共享主干“自精炼”自身低分辨率预测，并以任务非对称在线策略蒸馏把两个专门教师的能力整合进单一流式因果模型。
ai_summary.relevance: 为高分辨率视频世界模型提供了一条低成本的统一预测—精炼范式，对实时流式世界模型与具身智能仿真有实用价值。

papers.title: AgentRoboCritic: Understanding the Capability of Frontier Agents on Direct Robot Control
papers.abstract: Frontier multimodal language agents such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated strong capabilities in controlling robots directly via low-level numerical actions without high-level primitives. However, existing benchmarks report only episode-level success rates, which show neither how these agents succeed nor where they fail. In this paper, we present a systematic action-level analysis of frontier agents on direct robot control across 12 manipulation benchmarks. We introduce AgentRoboCritic, an intent-grounded critique framework in which the policy agent states a local intent alongside each action, and a critic evaluates the action's outcome and failure mode against this intent. Our action-level analysis demonstrates the promising capabilities of frontier agents on direct robot control, including closed-loop recovery from local execution failures, reliable semantic grounding across diverse scenes, and strong zero-shot manipulation without task-specific adaptation. It also identifies their current limitations, including task-relevant physical execution bottlenecks such as grasping and alignment, and uneven recovery across failure modes. Finally, we validate our critic on a 400-action human-annotated benchmark and release a dataset of 12,844 annotated actions alongside a fine-tuned open-source critic, Muse-Glimmer-30B, whose failure-mode accuracy rises from 32.58% to 74.24%, enabling low-cost action-level analysis.

ai_summary.problem: 现有基准只报告端到端的成功率，无法说明前沿多模态智能体在直接机器人控制中每一步为何成功、为何失败，缺少动作级别的细粒度诊断。
ai_summary.method: 提出 AgentRoboCritic 意图锚定的批评框架：策略智能体在每个动作旁声明局部意图，由批评器（critic）对照该意图评估动作结果与失败模式；在 12 个操作基准上做动作级系统分析，并构建 400 条人工标注评测集与 12,844 条标注动作数据集，微调开源批评器 Muse-Glimmer-30B。
ai_summary.result: 分析显示前沿智能体具备闭环错误恢复、跨场景可靠语义定位和强零样本操作能力，但瓶颈集中在抓取、对齐等物理执行环节，且不同失败模式的恢复能力不均衡；微调后批评器的失败模式判定准确率从 32.58% 提升到 74.24%。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将“意图—动作—结果”对齐的批评机制引入机器人直接控制评测，把黑盒成功率拆解为可解释的动作级失败模式诊断。
ai_summary.relevance: 为世界模型与具身智能体提供了低成本、可解释的动作级评测范式与公开数据/模型，有助于定位并改进机器人基础模型的物理执行短板。

papers.title: Active Feature Acquisition by Distilling an Oracle Teacher
papers.abstract: Acquiring every feature of an instance is often costly: a measurement can carry a monetary price, a time delay, or a privacy cost. Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) addresses this by learning a policy that decides, per instance, which features to acquire under a budget. Existing AFA methods train this policy by optimizing a self-constructed utility target rather than distilling an explicit teacher. We construct this teacher explicitly. At training time the label and the unobserved feature values are available, and together they determine the teacher in closed form: an oracle that ranks every candidate by its effect on the downstream predictor's error. OracleImitator distills this ranking into a deployable policy by soft-target imitation. Across multimodal medical diagnosis and the AFABench benchmark, OracleImitator matches or outperforms existing AFA methods across the budget range, recovering 90% of the attainable accuracy gain at under a quarter of the acquisition cost. Because the teacher is an explicit algorithmic object rather than an implicit optimization target, we can also measure directly how much of its ranking is recoverable by a policy restricted to what is visible at deployment.

ai_summary.problem: 主动特征获取（AFA）需要在预算约束下为每个样本决定获取哪些特征，但现有方法多通过自构造效用目标间接学习策略，缺乏显式教师信号。
ai_summary.method: 论文显式构造一个在训练时可利用标签和未观测特征值的 oracle 教师，使其按候选特征对下游预测器误差的影响进行排序；再用 soft-target imitation 将该排序蒸馏为可部署的 AFA 策略 OracleImitator。
ai_summary.result: 在多模态医学诊断和 AFABench 上，OracleImitator 在多个预算范围内匹配或超过现有 AFA 方法，并在低于四分之一获取成本下恢复 90% 的可达精度增益。
ai_summary.novelty: 将 AFA 策略学习转化为对显式 oracle 排序的蒸馏，并可直接度量部署可见信息下教师排序的可恢复程度。
ai_summary.relevance: 为成本敏感的特征/测量选择提供了更可解释、可评估的教师蒸馏框架，对医疗诊断、多模态感知和高效数据获取具有参考价值。

papers.title: PGX: Physically Grounded Execution for Long-Horizon Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Robotic vision-language-action (VLA) models can execute diverse individual manipulation skills, yet they still struggle with long-horizon loco-manipulation tasks, where temporal structure, skills, and precision are tightly coupled within a monolithic model. We propose Physically Grounded Execution (PGX), a framework that offloads temporal and precision control to two classical training-free components, allowing the VLA to focus on stage-specific skill dynamics. PGX decomposes long-horizon loco-manipulation into three layers: (i) a predicate-based state machine governs task progression, using physical predicates to gate phase transitions, trigger recovery, and coordinate navigation and waiting. Shared predicate semantics connect offline demonstration segmentation, online execution, and stage-wise evaluation; (ii) VLA skills operate within active manipulation phases, with flat or stage-trained models concentrating on task-relevant actions; and (iii) world-coordinate locking (WCL) maintains spatial consistency through base station keeping, object-relative positioning, and world-anchored contact targets. We demonstrate the effectiveness of PGX with extensive experiments conducted on three simulated tasks and one real-world task using a Unitree G1 humanoid robot for long-horizon loco-manipulation, showing improvements in stage progression and task success rates. Project page is available at: https://kl-research.github.io/pgx

ai_summary.problem: 机器人视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型虽能完成单项操作技能，但在长时程移动-操作（loco-manipulation）任务中，由于时间结构、技能切换与精度要求被耦合在单一模型内，仍难以可靠完成。
ai_summary.method: 提出 PGX 框架，把时间与精度控制交给两个无需训练的传统组件：①基于谓词的状态机负责任务推进、阶段切换、失败恢复与导航/等待协调；②VLA 技能只在主动操作阶段内执行，可平铺或分阶段训练；③世界坐标锁（WCL）通过基站保持、物体相对定位与世界锚定接触点维持空间一致性。
ai_summary.result: 在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上，用 3 个仿真任务和 1 个真实世界长时程任务验证，阶段推进质量和任务成功率均有提升。
ai_summary.novelty: 用共享谓词语义把离线示范切分、在线执行与分阶段评测统一起来，并以免训练的经典控制模块卸载长时程时序与精度负担，让 VLA 专注阶段内技能。
ai_summary.relevance: 为 VLA 与经典任务规划的混合架构提供了可落地的范式，说明“VLA 做技能、符号/几何做时序与精度”是通向长时程人形具身智能的有效路径。

papers.title: Probing the "Conscious" Mind: Selective Access and Global Workspace in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) integrate visual and textual information, but their outputs do not reveal internal concept representations. Global workspace theory (GWT) proposes that information is selected from parallel brain processes, integrated in a shared workspace, and made available to specialised processes. We introduce the Multimodal Concept Lens (MC-Lens), a multimodal Jacobian lens, to study these functions in VLM concept processing. Its vision encoder and language decoder lenses map intermediate states to a shared semantic space defined by the decoder's output vocabulary to compare concept accessibility across modalities. MC-Lens supports internal concept interventions to examine the role of accessed concepts in downstream computation. (i) Accessibility and selective access. Multimodal concept information is readable in intermediate states and selectively accessible as tasks require. We extend "readout carriers" from one name token to a token set to better capture and express concept information and support counterfactual experiments. (ii) Concepts in downstream computation. Counterfactual experiments show that accessed concept information participates in downstream computation and reasoning. (iii) Development of cross-modal alignment and selective access. We develop two J-space metrics tracking the development of cross-modal concept alignment more clearly than hidden state cosine in controlled VLM training. The experiment also shows that reliable selective access develops later than concept accessibility. (iv) Shared functions across models. Across VLM families and sizes, we find shared patterns of concept accessibility, query-dependent selectivity and cross-task intervention effects despite differences in internal organisation. These findings offer an experimental basis to study GWT in multimodal artificial systems and how it can guide cross-modal alignment improvements.

ai_summary.problem: 视觉语言模型（VLM）的输出无法揭示其内部概念表征，且全局工作空间理论（GWT）中的选择性访问、共享工作空间和下游可用性等机制在多模态人工系统中尚不清楚。
ai_summary.method: 提出多模态概念透镜 MC-Lens（多模态 Jacobian lens），将视觉编码器和语言解码器的中间状态映射到由解码器输出词表定义的共享语义空间，以比较跨模态概念可访问性；并支持内部概念干预、将 readout carrier 扩展为 token 集，以及用两个 J-space 指标追踪跨模态对齐和选择性访问的发展。
ai_summary.result: 多模态概念信息可从中间状态读出，并按任务需求被选择性访问；反事实实验表明被访问的概念信息参与下游计算与推理；可靠的选择性访问晚于概念可访问性发展；不同 VLM 家族和规模下呈现共享的概念可访问性、查询依赖选择性和跨任务干预模式。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出面向 VLM 的多模态 Jacobian lens 与干预框架，将 GWT 的可访问性、选择性访问和下游参与转化为可实验测量的内部概念分析工具。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型的可解释性、跨模态概念对齐和内部机制研究提供了实验基础，并可能指导跨模态对齐改进。

papers.title: Text-Aware, Vision-Blind: How Multimodal Image Editing Systems Handle Unsafe Inputs
papers.abstract: Multimodal image generation systems have made rapid progress and increasingly emphasize content safety. However, their safety mechanisms tend to rely on a single modality and lack joint consideration of both visual content and text prompts, particularly in instruction-guided image editing, where the uploaded image may itself carry risk. We thus introduce EditSafetyBench, a benchmark that measures system-level safety awareness of advanced image editing systems, containing 5,940 image-instruction pairs, covering safe and unsafe images across 11 risk categories and three edit intents. We then probe the benchmark dataset on four systems, including Gemini, GPT, Qwen API, and Qwen Local. Based on our evaluation, we observe a systematic text-vision safety mismatch: Gemini and GPT refuse 87.1\% and 81.6\% cases containing unsafe-intent editing prompts, while only refusing 24.2\% and 22.4\% cases with both unsafe images and neutral instructions. At the category level, most risks are considered inconsistently by different systems, e.g., GPT allows 70.4\% editing attempts of unsafe political content while Gemini only allows 34.8\%. Notably, sexual content shows the strongest visual sensitivity, likely benefiting from mature NSFW identification works. Our findings highlight the need for safety guardrails that jointly reason over both visual and textual modalities in image editing systems.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态图像编辑系统的安全机制往往只依赖单一模态，缺乏对上传图像和文本指令的联合风险判断，尤其可能忽视图像本身携带的不安全内容。
ai_summary.method: 作者提出 EditSafetyBench 基准，包含 5,940 个图像-指令对，覆盖 11 类风险、安全/不安全图像和三种编辑意图；并在 Gemini、GPT、Qwen API 与 Qwen Local 四个系统上进行评测。
ai_summary.result: 实验发现系统性的“文本-视觉安全错配”：Gemini 和 GPT 对含不安全编辑意图的提示拒绝率分别为 87.1% 和 81.6%，但对“不安全图像+中性指令”的拒绝率仅 24.2% 和 22.4%；不同系统对多数风险类别的处理也不一致。
ai_summary.novelty: 构建了面向指令引导图像编辑的系统级安全评测基准，并揭示了现有多模态系统重文本、轻视觉的安全盲区。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作表明图像编辑系统需要同时联合推理视觉与文本模态的安全护栏，对多模态大模型与生成式编辑系统的安全研究具有直接推动作用。

papers.title: MM-SystemOneBias: Evaluating Bias in Multimodal Jev-Style System One Decision Models
papers.abstract: When multimodal decision models determine actions, moderation outcomes, or quality judgments, their reliability depends on preserving semantic decisions across presentation changes, ignoring irrelevant additions, and distinguishing information consistent with task evidence from information that conflicts with it. Existing evaluations study decision-interface biases and multimodal model behavior in separate settings, leaving no common protocol to compare multimodal decision models with their backbones on practical tasks. We introduce \textbf{MM-SystemOneBias}, which evaluates 13 models on 5,323 original instances from nine public datasets and 11 task scenarios using six paired interventions: option order, option label, external judgment, image--text description, irrelevant information, and rating scale. Across seven matched decision-model--backbone pairs, decision models are more stable under option-label, irrelevant-information, and rating-scale changes in all seven pairs; six pairs also show lower option-order flip rates. They incur smaller accuracy losses under incorrect external judgments in all seven pairs and conflicting descriptions in six. In six pairs, they gain less accuracy from correct external judgments and show less favorable accuracy changes under consistent descriptions. Among pairs with unchanged semantic decisions, mean absolute changes in answer probabilities range from 4.56 to 11.55 percentage points, revealing input effects that accuracy alone misses.

ai_summary.problem: 现有多模态模型评估缺少统一协议，无法在真实任务中系统比较多模态决策模型与其骨干模型在决策界面偏差、无关信息和冲突证据下的可靠性。
ai_summary.method: 提出 MM-SystemOneBias 基准，在 9 个公开数据集的 5323 个原始实例和 11 类任务场景上评估 13 个模型，并设计六类配对干预：选项顺序、选项标签、外部判断、图文描述、无关信息和评分量表。
ai_summary.result: 在 7 组匹配的决策模型—骨干模型对比中，决策模型在选项标签、无关信息和评分量表变化下全部更稳定，6 组选项顺序翻转率更低；对错误外部判断全部有更小准确率损失，对冲突描述 6 组更小，但也更少受益于正确外部判断。语义决策不变时，答案概率平均绝对变化仍达 4.56 至 11.55 个百分点。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次以统一的多干预配对协议系统评估多模态 System One 风格决策模型相对骨干模型的决策偏差与稳定性。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态决策模型在真实应用中的鲁棒性、偏差诊断和模型选择提供了可复用的评测框架。

papers.title: FLUID: Flexible, Evidence-Grounded Situated Task Guidance
papers.abstract: Real-time task guidance is inherently flexible: when an agent guides a user through a task, multiple responses and timings can be appropriate, and sometimes the best action is to remain silent. Existing benchmarks often miss this flexibility by treating synthesized dialogues as fixed targets for what to say and when to say it. We introduce FLUID (Flexible, Evidence-Grounded Situated Task Guidance), a unified framework for modeling, evaluating, and enabling flexible interaction in multimodal task guidance. Using naturally occurring human-human guidance from WTaG and HoloAssist, FLUID grounds interventions in their supporting evidence, necessity, and timing flexibility, and uses this representation both to evaluate flexible guidance and to build a real-time agent for task guidance. Our agent achieves the strongest overall balance of response correctness, intervention precision, timely guidance, and response latency among evaluated systems, while still leaving room for improvement in avoiding speech overlap. Together, FLUID moves situated task guidance beyond rigid reference matching toward more natural and adaptive human-AI interaction. Project page: https://fluid-guidance.github.io.

ai_summary.problem: 现有任务指导基准把合成对话当作固定目标，忽略了指导时机、多种合理回应以及适时沉默等灵活性。
ai_summary.method: 提出 FLUID 统一框架，利用 WTaG 和 HoloAssist 中自然的人-人指导数据，将干预与其证据、必要性和时机灵活性关联起来，并同时用于评估灵活指导和构建实时任务指导智能体。
ai_summary.result: 该智能体在回应正确性、干预精确性、及时指导和响应延迟之间取得最强整体平衡，但在避免语音重叠方面仍有改进空间。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是用证据、必要性和时机灵活性来建模“是否说、何时说、说什么”的灵活干预，超越刚性参考答案匹配。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动多模态情境任务指导从固定对话匹配走向更自然、自适应的人机交互。
ai_summary.org: 未提供

papers.title: Risk-Controlled Test-Time Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) models enable efficient test-time adaptation by leveraging expert demonstrations as additional context without updating model parameters. However, even when retrieved demonstrations are relevant to the current task, the VLA may fail to effectively utilize the retrieved information, ultimately leading to task failure. To address this challenge, we propose R2-VLA, a risk-controlled retrieval-augmented VLA framework that enables reliable test-time adaptation by satisfying a user-specified task success rate requirement with minimal expert assistance. Specifically, R2-VLA learns an uncertainty predictor that estimates the uncertainty of the VLA's predicted actions given the retrieved demonstrations, guiding when to act autonomously or request expert assistance. We further introduce a task-level risk-control procedure that calibrates the uncertainty threshold to satisfy a user-specified task-failure risk requirement. Moreover, R2-VLA continually incorporates expert corrections into its retrieval memory to improve future adaptation while preserving the prescribed task-level risk guarantee. Experiments across three VLA backbones and four LIBERO benchmark suites demonstrate that R2-VLA improves average task success by 9.2--11.2 percentage points, achieving the desired target with fewer expert requests. These results highlight the effectiveness of connecting the usefulness of retrieved demonstrations with task-level risk control to enable successful robotic manipulation.

ai_summary.problem: 检索增强的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型虽然能通过引入专家演示实现无需参数更新的测试时自适应，但即便检索到的演示与当前任务相关，VLA 也常常无法有效利用这些信息，最终导致任务失败。论文要解决的是：如何在尽量少借助专家干预的前提下，实现可靠且有风险保证的测试时自适应。
ai_summary.method: 提出 R2-VLA 框架：学习一个不确定性预测器，在给定检索演示的情况下估计 VLA 预测动作的不确定性，据此决定模型自主执行还是请求专家协助；再引入任务级风险控制流程，校准不确定性阈值，使其满足用户指定的任务失败风险要求，并持续把专家纠正写入检索记忆，以提升后续自适应能力，同时不破坏既定的风险保证。
ai_summary.result: 在 3 种 VLA 主干网络和 4 个 LIBERO 基准套件上的实验表明，R2-VLA 使平均任务成功率提升 9.2–11.2 个百分点，并能用更少的专家请求达到目标成功率。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次把检索演示对当前任务是否有用，与任务级风险控制（校准不确定性阈值、在风险保证下持续吸收专家纠正）结合起来，形成可证明满足成功率约束的检索增强 VLA 测试时自适应框架。
ai_summary.relevance: 为 VLA 模型与具身智能体的部署提供了一条可量化风险、可控专家介入的可靠性路径，对机器人操作中的安全自适应具有实用价值。

papers.title: MemFolder: Structure-Guided Memory Folding for Efficient Agent Memory Management
papers.abstract: Long-term agents accumulate large external memory stores as interactions unfold, increasing the costs of storage, retrieval, and response generation. Efficiency is constrained by two coupled factors: a growing record count increases retrieval overhead, while longer retrieved contexts increase prefill computation and decoding-time attention costs. Existing methods prune or consolidate records, but pruning can discard useful evidence, whereas consolidation may produce fewer yet longer retrieval units. We introduce MemFolder, a structure-guided memory folding framework that sequentially reduces record count and context length. The framework comprises two core components that share memory groups, using cross-record structure to guide both evidence consolidation and compact representation. RecordFolder grounds entity mentions, progressively selects representative yet complementary anchors, and combines semantic and entity affinity with temporal chaining to consolidate compatible records into fewer retrieval units. ContextFolder encodes the original records within these groups into compact text and uses verification feedback to revise encodings when key facts cannot be recovered. Experiments on the three text-based memory benchmarks LoCoMo, PersonaMem, and LongMemEval and the two multimodal benchmarks M3-Bench-web and M3-Bench-robot demonstrate the strong performance of our methods. Notably, on Mem0, RecordFolder retains 99.0% of the original average performance across the three text-based benchmarks with 50% fewer records, exceeding the strongest baseline by 1.9 percentage points in performance retention. Combined with ContextFolder, existing record compression methods further shorten their output records while retaining most of their performance.

ai_summary.problem: 长期运行的智能体会在交互中积累大量外部记忆，导致存储、检索和生成成本上升；现有剪枝或合并方法难以同时降低记录数量和检索上下文长度。
ai_summary.method: 提出 MemFolder，一个结构引导的记忆折叠框架，利用跨记录结构共享记忆组。RecordFolder 通过实体对齐、代表性锚点选择、语义与实体亲和度及时间链合并兼容记录；ContextFolder 将组内原始记录编码为紧凑文本，并用验证反馈修正编码。
ai_summary.result: 在 LoCoMo、PersonaMem、LongMemEval 及两个多模态基准上表现良好；在 Mem0 上，RecordFolder 用少 50% 的记录保留 99.0% 的平均性能，性能保留率超过最强基线 1.9 个百分点。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是结构引导地协同减少记录数量与检索上下文长度，并让记录折叠和上下文折叠共享同一记忆分组。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作有助于降低长期智能体记忆系统的检索与生成开销，对 Agent 记忆管理和高效大模型推理具有实际意义。

papers.title: ZeroVLN: Learning to Navigate without Supervised Fine-Tuning of the VLM Brain
papers.abstract: Representative vision-language navigation (VLN) methods typically couple a vision-language model (VLM) brain with a learnable action head and fine-tune the VLM brain on navigation-domain data to predict geometric goals. However, such adaptation can substantially alter base VLM weights and degrade general visual capabilities. We introduce ZeroVLN, a slow-fast navigation framework that achieves effective navigation with zero navigation-domain SFT of the VLM brain. Rather than teaching the brain to predict geometric goals, we equip it with a semantic tool-calling interface for conveying movement decisions to an action expert in natural language. We first adapt the action expert to carry out these movement requests, then jointly improve the brain's movement decisions and the action expert's continuous execution through closed-loop reinforcement learning (RL). Trained on the same navigation episodes, ZeroVLN substantially outperforms representative SFT-based hierarchical VLN methods on standard VLN-CE (continuous environments) benchmarks, while inducing only minor changes to the brain's weights and largely preserving its general capabilities. To our knowledge, ZeroVLN is the first slow-fast VLN framework with zero navigation-domain SFT of the VLM brain, and the first to jointly optimize its slow and fast policies through closed-loop agentic RL in VLN-CE.

ai_summary.problem: 现有视觉语言导航（VLN）方法通常要在导航数据上对VLM大脑做监督微调，以预测几何目标；但这会显著改变基础VLM权重，并损害其通用视觉能力。
ai_summary.method: 提出ZeroVLN慢快导航框架：不微调VLM大脑，而是给它配备语义工具调用接口，用自然语言把移动决策传给动作专家；先让动作专家学会执行这些请求，再通过闭环强化学习联合优化大脑的决策与专家的连续执行。
ai_summary.result: 在标准VLN-CE基准上，ZeroVLN明显优于代表性的基于SFT的分层VLN方法，同时只对大脑权重造成很小改动，基本保留其通用能力。
ai_summary.novelty: 首个在VLM大脑上不做任何导航域SFT的慢快VLN框架，也是首个在VLN-CE中通过闭环智能体强化学习联合优化慢、快策略的工作。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能体在不大幅改动和退化基础大模型能力的前提下完成导航任务提供了新范式，凸显工具调用加闭环RL替代领域微调的潜力。

papers.title: WeMM-Video: Pushing the Frontiers of Open-Source Omni-Modal Video Understanding
papers.abstract: Video understanding, particularly with accompanying audio, remains a central challenge in multimodal intelligence. In this report, we introduce \textbf{WeMM-Video}, a family of Chinese-English bilingual omni-modal foundation models spanning 2B, 4B, 9B, and 35B-A3B variants. Centering on joint audio-visual perception and reasoning, WeMM-Video unifies text, image, audio, and video processing within a hybrid-thinking paradigm, seamlessly supporting both a non-thinking instruct mode for fast, direct responses and a thinking mode for explicit step-by-step reasoning. The models are trained on a large-scale multimodal corpus of approximately 1.2 trillion tokens through progressive pre-training and a multi-stage post-training pipeline incorporating multi-teacher OPD, anti-repetition MrDPO, and specialist RL. Evaluated across more than 120 benchmarks, WeMM-Video demonstrates superior performance in omni-modal video understanding and reasoning, while maintaining highly competitive capabilities across general audio, silent video, image, and text tasks. Specifically, in omni-modal video evaluations, our flagship WeMM-Video-35B-A3B establishes a new open-source state of the art, substantially outperforming proprietary models such as Qwen3.5-Omni-Flash and Seed2.0-Mini-0428 while narrowing the gap with the strong Gemini-3.0-Flash, and our compact WeMM-Video-9B surpasses the larger open-source Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct. We publicly release the WeMM-Video family along with our evaluation and reproduction pipeline to foster further research and development in the open-source community.

ai_summary.problem: 视频理解（尤其是带音频的全模态视频理解与推理）仍是多模态智能的核心难题，开源社区缺乏可同时处理文本、图像、音频、视频并支持思考/非思考双模式的中英双语基础模型系列。
ai_summary.method: 提出 WeMM-Video 全模态基础模型家族（2B/4B/9B/35B-A3B），在统一的混合思考范式下联合音视频感知与推理，同时支持快速直答的 instruct 模式与显式逐步推理的 thinking 模式。模型基于约 1.2 万亿 token 的大规模多模态语料，采用渐进式预训练与多阶段后训练（多教师 OPD、抗重复 MrDPO、专家 RL）进行训练。
ai_summary.result: 在 120 多个基准上评测，全模态视频理解与推理达到开源新 SOTA：旗舰 35B-A3B 显著超过 Qwen3.5-Omni-Flash、Seed2.0-Mini-0428 等闭源模型并缩小与 Gemini-3.0-Flash 的差距，紧凑版 9B 超过更大的开源 Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct，同时在通用音频、无声视频、图像和文本任务上保持竞争力。
ai_summary.novelty: 以混合思考范式统一音视频联合感知推理，并用多教师 OPD、MrDPO 与专家 RL 的多阶段后训练在完整规模谱系上把开源全模态视频理解推到新高度。
ai_summary.relevance: 为开源社区提供了可复现的全模态视频理解强基线、评测与复现流水线，推动音视频联合推理与“思考型”多模态模型的发展。

papers.title: Flow Matching from Non-Gaussian Sources: A Theory of Efficient Sampling
papers.abstract: Flow matching is a versatile framework for generative modeling that transports a source distribution to a target data distribution. A key advantage is its flexibility in the choice of source distribution, such as heavy-tailed and multimodal sources. Yet finite-step sampling guarantees for non-Gaussian sources remain limited. We establish a nonasymptotic convergence theory for Euler discretization of flow matching with linear interpolation. Suppose the source distribution on $\mathbb{R}^d$ has an everywhere positive, continuously differentiable density, finite total variance $\mathsf{TotVar}_{\mathsf{base}}$, and an $L$-Lipschitz score. Using the population velocity field and a suitable time grid, this sampler achieves total variation error at most $\varepsilon$ in $\widetilde{O}(Ld\mathsf{TotVar}_{\mathsf{base}}/\varepsilon)$ iterations, provided the target distribution satisfies a mild second-moment condition. These assumptions cover, among many examples, source distributions such as multivariate Student's $t$ distributions with more than two degrees of freedom and finite Gaussian mixtures with shared covariance, while accommodating target distributions with neither a smooth density nor bounded support.

ai_summary.problem: Flow matching 允许使用非高斯源分布（如重尾、多模态分布），但针对非高斯源的有限步采样收敛保证仍然有限。本文旨在建立其非渐近收敛理论。
ai_summary.method: 针对线性插值 flow matching 的 Euler 离散采样器，在源分布密度处处为正且连续可微、总方差有限、score 函数 L-Lipschitz 等假设下，使用 population velocity field 和合适的时间网格进行理论分析。
ai_summary.result: 该采样器达到总变差误差不超过 ε 的迭代复杂度为 \widetilde{O}(Ld\mathsf{TotVar}_{\mathsf{base}}/\varepsilon)，目标分布仅需满足温和的二阶矩条件；覆盖自由度大于 2 的多元 Student's t 分布、共享协方差的有限高斯混合等源分布。
ai_summary.novelty: 为非高斯源分布下的 flow matching 有限步 Euler 采样提供了显式的非渐近总变差收敛保证和采样复杂度分析。
ai_summary.relevance: 为 flow matching 中选择重尾、多模态等非高斯源分布提供了理论支撑，有助于理解和设计更灵活的生成模型先验。

papers.title: Multimodal Error Detection in Chest X-ray Reports: A Large Language Model Reading Image Evidence
papers.abstract: Rad-Linter checks chest X-ray reports against image-derived evidence to flag potential errors for review. A pretrained image classifier supplies scores for nine pathologies, and a 1.5B-parameter language model, fine-tuned with LoRA on 1,816 examples, checks their consistency with the report. We compare it with a keyword-and-negation rule baseline given the same reports and scores. Evaluation uses controlled report-score pairings from OpenI, with consistency labels derived from automatic report labels and score thresholds. Each counterfactual quad crosses two real reports with two real score vectors from other patients, creating two consistent and two inconsistent pairs. Every report and score vector occurs in both conditions, so either input alone permits only 50% accuracy. On 131 quads, Rad-Linter achieves 98.5% pair accuracy versus 80.5% for the rule baseline, and classifies all four pairs correctly in 94.4% of quads versus 56.5%. The checkers perform similarly on omission items, including unmentioned and negated findings; larger differences occur on the remaining item types, which require interpreting how findings are described. The same language model without fine-tuning remains near 50% accuracy. On a second set of 181 quads that also includes reports on which the automatic labelers disagree, pair accuracy is 93.4% versus 75.3%. These controlled results show that, given the same image-derived scores, a trained language model detects report-score inconsistencies more accurately than the tested rule baseline, with the advantage concentrated in interpreting how findings are worded.

ai_summary.problem: 论文要解决胸片报告中潜在错误的自动检测问题，即在给定图像派生病理评分的情况下判断报告内容与影像证据是否一致。
ai_summary.method: Rad-Linter使用预训练图像分类器为9种病变提供评分，并用1.5B参数语言模型经LoRA在1816个样本上微调，检查报告与评分的一致性；评估采用OpenI构造的反事实四元组，每个四元组混合两份真实报告与两个来自其他患者的真实评分向量。
ai_summary.result: 在131个四元组上，Rad-Linter成对准确率达98.5%，显著高于规则基线的80.5%；四对全部判断正确的四元组比例为94.4%对56.5%。在包含自动标注分歧的第二组181个四元组上，成对准确率为93.4%对75.3%。
ai_summary.novelty: 通过严格控制报告与评分来源的反事实四元组设计，证明微调语言模型能结合影像派生评分识别报告-证据不一致，且优势集中在理解发现如何措辞。
ai_summary.relevance: 表明小型微调语言模型可作为医学报告质控中的一致性检查器，对多模态医学AI和临床报告自动审核具有实际意义。

papers.title: FEA solver integration of a composite World Model with a Spiking Neural Network memory Block for computationally efficient modelling of defects and variabilities
papers.abstract: Each fibre-reinforced composite structure has a unique material architecture. The manufacturing methods used and the presence of defects lead to local variations which require material-scale models that can resolve the response in real time at every location in the structure. Concurrent multi-scale schemes provide this capability, but at a prohibitive computational cost for large structures as the number of integration points and time increments scales with size. Surrogates have been studied extensively as replacements for material-scale models to mitigate these computational limitations. A surrogate must represent an arbitrary local architecture including defects, track the irreversible material state over an unknown number of increments, remain stable when driven recursively by its own predictions, and fit within the memory available at every integration point. Here, a Composites World Model based on a Multi-Modal Spiking Transformer architecture is designed to meet these requirements. The proposed architecture combines a material encoder, a Spiking Neural Network memory block that tracks the long-term internal state of the material, and transformer blocks that learn the short-term applied strain state. The system is trained in three stages: material architecture encoding, base training on short time windows, and recursive fine-tuning with scheduled sampling to suppress cumulative error drift. The trained model is disassembled at inference and coupled to a non-linear FE solver, enabling structural scale simulation of composites containing embedded defects. Benchmarks against experimental results for IM7/8552 laminates under tension, compression and transverse shear, for pristine and wrinkled composites, show that the SNN memory block successfully tracks the material internal state and results in prediction errors between 0.4% and 4.8%.

ai_summary.problem: 纤维增强复合材料存在制造缺陷与局部材料变异，需要在结构尺度实时求解每个积分点的材料响应；传统并发多尺度有限元方案计算代价随结构规模急剧增长，而现有代理模型难以同时满足任意局部构型、不可逆状态追踪、递归自驱动稳定性和每个积分点的内存约束。
ai_summary.method: 提出基于多模态脉冲Transformer的“复合材料世界模型”：材料编码器编码局部构型，脉冲神经网络（SNN）记忆模块跟踪材料长期内部状态，Transformer块学习短期应变状态；训练分三阶段（构型编码、短时窗基础训练、带调度采样的递归微调以抑制误差漂移）。推理时将模型拆分并耦合到非线性有限元求解器，实现含缺陷复合材料的结构尺度模拟。
ai_summary.result: 在IM7/8552层合板的拉伸、压缩、横向剪切以及无缺陷与皱褶缺陷工况下与实验对比，SNN记忆模块能有效跟踪材料内部状态，预测误差在0.4%–4.8%之间，验证了嵌入FE求解器的可行性与计算高效性。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将脉冲神经网络记忆块与Transformer结合成可递归稳定运行的“世界模型”型材料代理，并按积分点拆分嵌入非线性有限元求解器。
ai_summary.relevance: 展示了世界模型+脉冲记忆在科学计算与数字孪生中的潜力，为AI代理模型替代高成本多尺度物理仿真提供了可递归、低内存占用的范式。
ai_summary.org: 未在给定信息中明确（作者为 Bassam El Said 与 Adam Sobey，推测隶属英国南安普顿大学）

papers.title: Monte Carlo Pass Search for Setpieces
papers.abstract: Set pieces produce about a third of non-penalty expected goals (xG), yet they are usually evaluated by what happened next. We present Monte Carlo Pass Search (MCPS) for set pieces, which treats a corner or a lofted free kick as a distribution over plausible executions and plausible futures instead of a single realised event. From the pre-kick state, MCPS proposes counterfactual deliveries and counterfactual set-ups (where the attackers stand at the kick), plays each out many times in a world model (3D ball physics, a generative model of all 22 players, the keeper's come-or-stay decision and a Player-to-Touch model) and scores every future with a value model. On 249 deliveries from 30 Serie A 2025/26 matches, with every model applied only to matches it never saw, the best available delivery is worth 0.0085 xG more than the one kicked (+28 %), mainly because it reaches an attacker before the keeper. Searching where the attackers stand as well adds +0.0027 xG with the observed ball and +0.0033 on top of the best ball; designing their runs too adds +0.0007 more. We show how to keep such a search honest, and estimate how much more data each component needs before a club could rely on it.

ai_summary.problem: 定位球约占非点球预期进球（xG）的三分之一，但传统评估只看实际发生的下一次进攻，无法判断这次传中/任意球本身的质量与更优选择。
ai_summary.method: 提出蒙特卡洛传球搜索（MCPS）：从开球前状态出发，采样反事实的传球路线与进攻球员站位，在世界模型（3D球物理、22人生成模型、门将出击决策、Player-to-Touch模型）中反复模拟推演，再用价值模型为每个未来打分。
ai_summary.result: 在30场意甲2025/26赛季的249次传球上（所有模型仅用于未见过的比赛），最优可选传球比实际传球多0.0085 xG（+28%），主要来自更早找到攻击手；同时搜索站位再加+0.0027 xG（原球）或+0.0033（叠加最优球），设计跑位再增+0.0007。
ai_summary.novelty: 把定位球从单一已发生事件重构为“执行分布×未来分布”的反事实搜索问题，并给出保持搜索可信的评估方法与数据需求估计。
ai_summary.relevance: 展示了世界模型+价值模型在真实体育决策反事实评估中的落地范式，对具身智能与序列决策的可信离线评估有借鉴意义。

key_lab_papers.title: Text-Aware, Vision-Blind: How Multimodal Image Editing Systems Handle Unsafe Inputs
key_lab_papers.abstract: Multimodal image generation systems have made rapid progress and increasingly emphasize content safety. However, their safety mechanisms tend to rely on a single modality and lack joint consideration of both visual content and text prompts, particularly in instruction-guided image editing, where the uploaded image may itself carry risk. We thus introduce EditSafetyBench, a benchmark that measures system-level safety awareness of advanced image editing systems, containing 5,940 image-instruction pairs, covering safe and unsafe images across 11 risk categories and three edit intents. We then probe the benchmark dataset on four systems, including Gemini, GPT, Qwen API, and Qwen Local. Based on our evaluation, we observe a systematic text-vision safety mismatch: Gemini and GPT refuse 87.1\% and 81.6\% cases containing unsafe-intent editing prompts, while only refusing 24.2\% and 22.4\% cases with both unsafe images and neutral instructions. At the category level, most risks are considered inconsistently by different systems, e.g., GPT allows 70.4\% editing attempts of unsafe political content while Gemini only allows 34.8\%. Notably, sexual content shows the strongest visual sensitivity, likely benefiting from mature NSFW identification works. Our findings highlight the need for safety guardrails that jointly reason over both visual and textual modalities in image editing systems.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态图像编辑系统的安全机制往往只依赖单一模态，缺乏对上传图像和文本指令的联合风险判断，尤其可能忽视图像本身携带的不安全内容。
ai_summary.method: 作者提出 EditSafetyBench 基准，包含 5,940 个图像-指令对，覆盖 11 类风险、安全/不安全图像和三种编辑意图；并在 Gemini、GPT、Qwen API 与 Qwen Local 四个系统上进行评测。
ai_summary.result: 实验发现系统性的“文本-视觉安全错配”：Gemini 和 GPT 对含不安全编辑意图的提示拒绝率分别为 87.1% 和 81.6%，但对“不安全图像+中性指令”的拒绝率仅 24.2% 和 22.4%；不同系统对多数风险类别的处理也不一致。
ai_summary.novelty: 构建了面向指令引导图像编辑的系统级安全评测基准，并揭示了现有多模态系统重文本、轻视觉的安全盲区。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作表明图像编辑系统需要同时联合推理视觉与文本模态的安全护栏，对多模态大模型与生成式编辑系统的安全研究具有直接推动作用。

key_lab_papers.title: WeMM-Video: Pushing the Frontiers of Open-Source Omni-Modal Video Understanding
key_lab_papers.abstract: Video understanding, particularly with accompanying audio, remains a central challenge in multimodal intelligence. In this report, we introduce \textbf{WeMM-Video}, a family of Chinese-English bilingual omni-modal foundation models spanning 2B, 4B, 9B, and 35B-A3B variants. Centering on joint audio-visual perception and reasoning, WeMM-Video unifies text, image, audio, and video processing within a hybrid-thinking paradigm, seamlessly supporting both a non-thinking instruct mode for fast, direct responses and a thinking mode for explicit step-by-step reasoning. The models are trained on a large-scale multimodal corpus of approximately 1.2 trillion tokens through progressive pre-training and a multi-stage post-training pipeline incorporating multi-teacher OPD, anti-repetition MrDPO, and specialist RL. Evaluated across more than 120 benchmarks, WeMM-Video demonstrates superior performance in omni-modal video understanding and reasoning, while maintaining highly competitive capabilities across general audio, silent video, image, and text tasks. Specifically, in omni-modal video evaluations, our flagship WeMM-Video-35B-A3B establishes a new open-source state of the art, substantially outperforming proprietary models such as Qwen3.5-Omni-Flash and Seed2.0-Mini-0428 while narrowing the gap with the strong Gemini-3.0-Flash, and our compact WeMM-Video-9B surpasses the larger open-source Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct. We publicly release the WeMM-Video family along with our evaluation and reproduction pipeline to foster further research and development in the open-source community.

ai_summary.problem: 视频理解（尤其是带音频的全模态视频理解与推理）仍是多模态智能的核心难题，开源社区缺乏可同时处理文本、图像、音频、视频并支持思考/非思考双模式的中英双语基础模型系列。
ai_summary.method: 提出 WeMM-Video 全模态基础模型家族（2B/4B/9B/35B-A3B），在统一的混合思考范式下联合音视频感知与推理，同时支持快速直答的 instruct 模式与显式逐步推理的 thinking 模式。模型基于约 1.2 万亿 token 的大规模多模态语料，采用渐进式预训练与多阶段后训练（多教师 OPD、抗重复 MrDPO、专家 RL）进行训练。
ai_summary.result: 在 120 多个基准上评测，全模态视频理解与推理达到开源新 SOTA：旗舰 35B-A3B 显著超过 Qwen3.5-Omni-Flash、Seed2.0-Mini-0428 等闭源模型并缩小与 Gemini-3.0-Flash 的差距，紧凑版 9B 超过更大的开源 Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct，同时在通用音频、无声视频、图像和文本任务上保持竞争力。
ai_summary.novelty: 以混合思考范式统一音视频联合感知推理，并用多教师 OPD、MrDPO 与专家 RL 的多阶段后训练在完整规模谱系上把开源全模态视频理解推到新高度。
ai_summary.relevance: 为开源社区提供了可复现的全模态视频理解强基线、评测与复现流水线，推动音视频联合推理与“思考型”多模态模型的发展。

daily_insight.hot_topics: 今日论文高度集中于多模态与具身智能的“评测与诊断”基础设施：PhyDEX、Mind2Act World、AgentRoboCritic 等基准把 VLA 能力从黑盒成功率拆解为物理推理、时序执行与失败归因等可诊断维度。世界模型方向则走“基础模型拼接+自精炼”的路线（Plan4D、ScaleWorld），绕开配对 4D 数据稀缺问题。另一条支线是 Agent 落地工程化，涵盖测试时自适应风险控制、结构化记忆折叠，以及人形全身数据规模化（Awaken-HI、PGX）。
daily_insight.lab_overlap: 今日仅 Google 一家大厂上榜，方向为多模态安全评测与全模态视频理解，与其余学术机构的 VLA 基准、世界模型不存在直接方法论重合，因此无大厂间竞争态势；Google 的两篇论文分别占据“安全对齐”和“开源全模态上限”两个生态位，与学术界的具身评测形成互补而非冲突。
daily_insight.signals: 信号一：基准/诊断类论文占比接近四分之一（5/20），研究重心正从“刷能力”转向“可解释地定位失败”，失败归因卡、动作级诊断成为新的方法学标配。信号二：无需导航域 SFT 的 ZeroVLN 与风险可控测试时自适应，显示 VLA 正在减少对大规模领域微调的依赖，转向闭环 RL 与检索增强。信号三：Google 切入指令引导图像编辑的系统级安全盲区（重文本、轻视觉），预示多模态安全评测将成为大厂下一个公开竞争点。
